title: Honey Pistachio and Almond Nougat
summary: Chewy white honey nougat packed with warm toasted pistachios and almonds, set overnight and cut into bars.
equipment: 2 digital thermometers (or one, rinsed between pans)

ingredients.item: egg whites (from 2 large eggs), pasteurised if you like
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Line the tin
steps.text: Line the tin with baking paper and dust the paper generously with cornflour so the nougat releases cleanly.

steps.title: Warm the nuts
steps.text: Toast the pistachios and almonds on the tray at 160 °C for 8 min, until just fragrant. Turn the oven off and leave them inside to stay warm; warm nuts fold in far more easily.

steps.title: Heat the honey
steps.text: Warm the honey in one small pan over medium heat until it reads 121 °C, about 5 min. Take it off the heat; it foams up, so use a pan with room to spare.

steps.title: Boil the sugar syrup
steps.text: Put the sugar, corn syrup and water in the second pan over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Then stop stirring and boil for 10-12 min, until the syrup reads 152 °C and is still clear or barely coloured.

steps.title: Whip the whites
steps.text: As the sugar syrup passes about 130 °C, start whisking the egg whites with the salt in the mixer until they hold soft peaks.

steps.title: Add the hot syrups
steps.text: With the mixer on medium-high, pour in the honey in a thin stream down the side of the bowl, then add the hot sugar syrup the same way. Keep the stream away from the whisk so it does not spin into threads.

steps.title: Beat until thick
steps.text: Keep whisking for 6-8 min, adding the vanilla near the end. It is ready when it is very thick, glossy, pulls away from the bowl and is only just warm.

steps.title: Fold in the nuts
steps.text: Tip in the warm nuts and fold quickly with the oiled spatula; the mixture is sticky and stiffens fast.

steps.title: Leave to set
steps.text: Press into the tin and smooth the top with oiled hands or the spatula. Dust with a little cornflour and leave uncovered at room temperature for 8 h or overnight, until firm.

steps.title: Cut into bars
steps.text: Lift the nougat out and cut it into 24 bars with the oiled knife, wiping and re-oiling the blade between cuts.

tips: The most common mistake is pulling the sugar syrup too early; below about 150 °C the nougat stays soft and sags, so trust the thermometer.
Make it on a dry day; humidity makes nougat sticky.
Egg safety: the hot syrup cooks the egg white well above 71 °C. For extra peace of mind use pasteurised egg white; if your pasteurised whites will not whip, add a pinch of cream of tartar.
Hot sugar causes severe burns; keep children away and a bowl of cold water nearby.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Wrap the bars individually in baking paper and keep in an airtight container at cool room temperature for up to 2 weeks.
